# Kuotivo

> Window and fenestration quoting software for Indian fabricators. Draw a window
> on a grid, Kuotivo generates a real shop drawing and prices it from your rate
> card, then turns the quotation into a GST tax invoice and tracks the money.

In production since 25 July 2026. Built and operated by Aayush Vaghela.
Contact: aayush@kuotivo.in · Application: https://app.kuotivo.in

## Who it is for

Small and mid-sized Indian fabrication businesses: aluminium windows and doors,
structural glazing, railing, modular furniture and interior work. Typically an
owner who writes his own quotations and invoices, one or two staff, and a few
hundred documents a year.

## What makes it different

Most quoting software treats a window as a line item. A window quotation is
actually a list of drawings with sizes, so Kuotivo generates the drawing.

You lay a window out as a grid. Column widths and row heights in millimetres,
and what each panel does. From that it produces a shop drawing a fabricator can
work from: dimension chains, a plan strip, opening-direction arrows, a legend and
a VIEW FROM INSIDE annotation.

- 12 panel kinds: fixed, openable, sliding, sliding door, casement left/right,
  awning, hopper, louver, exhaust fan, door left/right
- Merged panels via column and row spans. A full-width top light over two
  sliders, a tall fixed pane beside a slider
- Sliders of 1 to 4 tracks with forced shutter direction, so a centre-opening
  pair draws correctly
- Two mosquito-mesh modes: mesh on its own track of a 3-track slider, or a
  separate fixed frame over the panel. Modelled as a choice because both at once
  is not buildable
- Arched heads (semicircular, segmental, stilted) as extra geometry above an
  unchanged rectangular grid
- Palladian heads, which change the price: the area above the flat shoulders is
  deducted from billable area

The drawing engine is a pure library with no database or network access, so the
price calculation, the live browser preview and the PDF all call the same code.

## Indian GST

- CGST + SGST or IGST is decided from the customer's GST state code against the
  company's, and is recomputed from the customer at invoice conversion rather
  than copied from the quotation
- Gap-free statutory numbering per financial year, unique per business, e.g.
  QT/26-27/00042, INV/26-27/00010, RCPT/26-27/00003
- HSN and SAC codes per invoice line
- Reverse charge, e-way bill number and vehicle number
- Rounding is stored and shown as its own visible line
- The financial year rolls in April and each year has its own counter

## Modules

Dashboard · Alerts · Customers · Quotations · Invoices · Money to Collect ·
Window Types · Rate Cards · Reports · Users · Audit Logs · Settings

Billing units are per piece, per square foot or per running foot, and a line can
be shown in square feet or square metres. Nine trade categories: aluminium,
glazing, railing, furniture, interior, electrical, painting, civil and custom.

## Reference customer

Aastha Enterprise, Vadodara, Gujarat. Aluminium, glazing and furniture
fabrication, proprietor Hitesh Panchal. Before Kuotivo, each quotation was built
by drawing every window in AutoCAD, exporting it as an image and pasting it into
a hand-made layout: one to two hours per quotation. Invoices were written in
Microsoft Word.
